text:
nina: Quick follow-up from today’s infra Q&A. Two asks from GTM/CS: (1) a one-line customer-safe sentence about APAC pilot timing we can paste into emails, and (2) a short bullets list of what customers will see if a region runs low. Can infra confirm?

sophia: One-liner draft: "Targeting an invite-only APAC pilot in late Sept; broader availability expected in early Q4, subject to hardware deliveries and vendor timing." Use "target" + "subject to" phrasing.

carlos: For the customer-visible bullets, keep them simple. CS wants copy like: "If your region is busy, requests may be routed elsewhere and latency can increase; you will see the routing region on the request logs."

sophia: Short bullets we can ship: - We prefer in-region capacity first. - If capacity is limited, requests may be routed to the nearest available region (this can increase latency). - As a last resort, we may serve a reduced-memory model variant which can impact latency and occasionally quality. - Dedicated/Private customers with region-pinning will not be routed cross-region unless they opt-in.

marta: Legal/Exec asked for neutral language on dates. Suggest we add: "dates are estimates and subject to supply chain changes."

sophia: Agreed. We'll add that sentence.

lisa: Procurement flag: vendor G reports a 10-day slip on one APAC crate, approximate impact: APAC buffer -7%. Posting details to #procurement-watch.

capacity-bot: capacity snapshot (ts 2145608800):
US-West: 92%
US-East: 89%
EMEA: 67%
APAC: 42%

carlos: Can infra provide rough p95 numbers for each fallback so CS can set expectations? We don't need exacts, just ballpark ranges.

sophia: Ballpark p95 deltas: in-region warm failover: +10-30ms; cross-region (same continent): +60-220ms depending on distance; reduced-memory variant: +120-400ms and possible small quality regression. We'll publish a measured table next week.

marta: Exec-comm wants to approve the one-liner before we send to customers. Can you tag them when it's final?

sophia: Will post final draft here and @exec-comm.

lisa: Ops ask: can infra add a metric `infra_region_state{region}` with values normal/strained/critical so on-call dashboards and CS filters can be simpler?

sophia: Yes, we'll emit `infra_region_state` and a short Grafana panel for it. Also adding `infra_fallback_reason` logs for pilot accounts to help CS troubleshoot.

nina: Tiny request: can someone drop a 1-paragraph internal FAQ (non-public) with the bullets + the p95 ballparks so CS has a paste-ready answer? That helps reduce back-and-forth with customers.

sophia: I'll add an internal FAQ doc and paste the snippet here when ready (due Mon).

carlos: One more ops note: for pilot customers, add an account-level toggle to disable cross-region routing (region-only mode). That was requested by a few early customers.

sophia: We'll support an account toggle for pilot accounts; will warn about failures when local capacity runs out. For Dedicated, region-pinning already exists.

marta: Sounds good. Action items recap: sophia -> final one-liner + internal FAQ + p95 table (due Mon); lisa -> procurement details in #procurement-watch (today); infra -> `infra_region_state` metric + Grafana panel (due Tue); sophia -> tag exec-comm when final blurb is posted.

nina: Thanks everyone. Please @nina when the one-liner is approved so I can coordinate CS email. :thumbsup:
